# Annotations to ignore in /review-annotations.
# One pattern per line (grep -F string match against annotation message).
# Lines starting with # are comments. Keep patterns short and uniquely specific.
#
# When you add a new entry: include a comment with the reason and, if applicable,
# a tracking link (bead ID, upstream issue, dep upgrade PR).

# Kotlin Multiplatform expect/actual classes are in Beta. We use them in
# data-network and ios-swift-di for platform bridges. The warning will go
# away when KT-61573 graduates expect/actual classes to stable.
'expect'/'actual' classes (including interfaces, objects, annotations, enums, and 'actual' typealiases) are in Beta

# AGP / KMP plugin compatibility deprecation. Migration is tracked separately
# (kotl.in/kmp-project-structure-migration); the warning fires per module on
# every build.
The 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.multiplatform' plugin deprecated compatibility with Android Gradle plugin

# Gradle 9 deprecation umbrella warning. Aggregated message, not a specific
# code-site issue.
Deprecated Gradle features were used in this build, making it incompatible with Gradle 9.0.

# LocalClipboardManager deprecation is intentionally suppressed at the call
# site (PR #1105). CMP 1.10's LocalClipboard requires an expect/actual
# ClipEntry factory; the migration is deferred until that abstraction lands.
